name: Paharganj and the station concourse
notes: Cows are listed as rare because the sheet names them twice among the lane's animals; no worship type is generated from this profile. The Ajmeri Gate side forecourt is in gb_road_ajmeri_gate.

materials: carved brackets on old haveli fragments
buildings.balconies: balconies and rooftop terraces; old haveli fragments with carved brackets
buildings.roofline: rooftop terraces with cell masts, dish antennas and lit hoardings

gate_and_window_grilles.kind: roll-down shutters in many colours (blue is common), iron gates, narrow arch entrances for old lanes

footpath.surface: about 1 m of broken concrete or paver at the shopfronts, a 2 m kerbed uneven walk on Desh Bandhu Gupta Road, a wide grey granite tile forecourt at the station
footpath.kerb: uneven kerb on Desh Bandhu Gupta Road, none at the shopfronts

lamps.kind: bare bulbs and tube lights at shopfronts, a few sodium street poles, neon hotel signs and lit roof hoardings

kinds: walls of old havelis with brackets

signs.boards: hotel and guesthouse signs stacked on every floor, lit roof hoardings and neon, most in English

life.people: residents, shopkeepers, porters, fruit sellers and tailors, travellers and visitors from many countries; the market runs day and night

road.condition: Main Bazaar about 7 to 8 m of patched asphalt or concrete with no lane lines; Desh Bandhu Gupta Road four lanes one way with painted dashes; faded lines under the flyover
